title: Convert Header To
description: Converts the message header to another type

id.title: Id
id.description: Sets the id of this node

note.title: Note
note.description: Sets the note of this node

description.title: Description
description.description: Sets the description of this node

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disables this EIP from the route.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of message header to convert its value The simple language can be used to define a dynamic evaluated header name to be used. Otherwise a constant name will be used.

type.title: Type
type.description: The java type to convert to

toName.title: To Name
toName.description: To use another header to store the result. By default, the result is stored in the same header. This option allows to use another header. The simple language can be used to define a dynamic evaluated header name to be used. Otherwise a constant name will be used.

mandatory.title: Mandatory
mandatory.description: When mandatory then the conversion must return a value (cannot be null), if this is not possible then NoTypeConversionAvailableException is thrown. Setting this to false could mean conversion is not possible and the value is null.

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: To use a specific charset when converting
